List item containing multiple paragraphs

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<ul><li><p>First paragraph in item.</p><p>Second paragraph in item.</p></li><li>Simple item</li></ul>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
